scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:smoke && npm run build:smoke:lycee && npm run smoke && npm run pwa

scripts.app:win: vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never && npm run app:win:lycee
scripts.app:win:lycee: vite build --mode lycee --outDir dist-lycee && electron-builder --win --publish never -c electron-builder.lycee.yml
